four_original_terminal_headers.literal_source_statement:
theorem dyadic_mean (L : Finset ℕ+) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1≤K)
    (level : ∀ k ∈ L, K≤(k.val:ℝ) ∧ (k.val:ℝ)≤2*K)
    (M N : ℕ) (a b c d : ℕ+ → ℕ)
    (length₁ : ∀ k ∈ L, a k≤b k ∧ b k-a k≤M)
    (length₂ : ∀ k ∈ L, c k≤d k ∧ d k-c k≤N) (ω : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ L, inverseShortMean k (Ico (a k) (b k)) (Ico (c k) (d k)) ω) ≤
      6000*(1+Real.log (1+12*K))*
        (K*(M:ℝ)*(N:ℝ)+K^2*(harmonic M:ℝ)*(harmonic N:ℝ))

theorem total_mean (L : Finset ℕ+) (X M N : ℕ) (cap : ∀ k ∈ L, k.val≤X)
    (a b c d : ℕ) (hab : a≤b) (hcd : c≤d) (hm : b-a≤M) (hn : d-c≤N) (ω : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ L, inverseShortMean k (Ico a b) (Ico c d) ω) ≤
      12000*(1+Real.log (1+12*(X:ℝ)))*((X:ℝ)*((M:ℝ)*N)+(X:ℝ)^2*((harmonic M:ℝ)*(harmonic N:ℝ)))

theorem initial_mean {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (L : Finset ℕ+) (X M N : ℕ), 1≤X → 1≤M → 1≤N →
      (∀ k ∈ L, k.val≤X) → ∀ (a b c d : ℕ), a≤b → c≤d → b-a≤M → d-c≤N → ∀ ω : ℝ,
      (∑ k ∈ L, inverseShortMean k (Ico a b) (Ico c d) ω) ≤
        C*((X:ℝ)*M*N)^ε*(X:ℝ)*((X:ℝ)+(M:ℝ)*N)

theorem initial_opened_mean {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (L : Finset ℕ+) (X M N : ℕ), 1≤X → 1≤M → 1≤N →
      (∀ k ∈ L, k.val≤X) → ∀ (a b c d : ℕ), a≤b → c≤d → b-a≤M → d-c≤N → ∀ ω : ℝ,
      (∑ k ∈ L, ‖∑ m ∈ Ico a b, ∑ n ∈ Ico c d,
        phaseAt ω m*phaseAt (-ω) n*kloosterman k.val (m:ℤ) (n:ℤ)‖) ≤
        C*((X:ℝ)*M*N)^ε*(X:ℝ)*((X:ℝ)+(M:ℝ)*N)
